title: PyNetDesign: a Python framework for microseismic monitoring network design
description: PyNetDesign is an open-source Python library that provides a simple and functional framework for designing and testing microseismic monitoring networks. Version 1.0.1 is a bugfix release. It corrects the seismic moment calculation, which underestimated the moment by a factor of 2*pi*f because the amplitude-to-displacement spectral conversion was applied twice. Minimum detectable moment magnitudes reported by version 1.0.0 were too low by roughly 1.0 to 1.9 magnitude units, by an amount that varies with the source-receiver distance, so results produced with version 1.0.0 should be recomputed. The release also restores Python 3.9 compatibility of the visualization module, removes a non-functional location uncertainty routine that referenced functions absent from the package, and adds a test module covering the magnitude relations.
